subtitle: A serviceable hydraulic integration deck
description: A compact reservoir and removable equipment deck reserve space for a bought motor-pump, valve manifold and filtration. This is packaging CAD, not a designed hydraulic circuit.
targets: Unbaffled volume; usable oil level unassigned
Derive from selected caliper and release timing
decisions: Buy qualified hydraulic components and manifold rather than machine custom pressure passages.
Use a removable deck for bench service and clearly separated fill/drain access.
Allocate pressure sensing and filtered breather space early; select hardware after the circuit review.
materials: Reservoir: S355J2+N candidate welded sheet; cleanliness and coating compatibility require review.
Pump, motor, valve block and filter: purchased certified components.
risks: No circuit, relief setting, accumulator sizing or failure-state analysis is completed.
Reserved component volumes are not vendor dimensions.
Reservoir baffles, suction conditions and thermal dissipation remain unresolved.
steps: Approve circuit and equipment list before cutting sheet.
Fabricate and leak-test reservoir to approved welding and cleaning procedure.
Install removable deck and selected component brackets.
Fit piping, flushing, relief protection and controls per approved hydraulic schematic.
validation: Circuit failure analysis, pressure transients, oil temperature and cleanliness.
Leak, flush, loss-of-power and repeated application/release tests.
hypotheses: Compare equipment access against a fixed-deck baseline.
Compare qualified vendor quotations, not assumed unit costs.
sensors: Define pressure transducer, oil level/temperature, filter clog switch, motor starter, E-stop interaction and independent safe valve state.
